scope: Actual React board and CSS with controlled UI fixtures; no engine commands or external writes

scenarios.name: Attachment label keeps rank and suit together in one compact wrapping text block
Complete move plays once on click, including rapid duplicate events
Single target choice plays immediately without Confirm
The same single choice plays directly when picked on the battlefield
Editable source and target composition waits for its final commit
A legal smaller card set remains editable before committing the larger set
Expanded Pending Plays and history stay reachable in the left rail at short and tall desktop sizes
